summary: CHECK NOT VALID, VALIDATE, then SET NOT NULL (no scan on PG 12+).

stages.description: Metadata-only on PG 11+: existing rows read the default.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ADD COLUMN marketing_opt_in boolean DEFAULT false

stages.description: Deploy the new version; its migration only updates Django state.
VALIDATE takes a lock that does not block writes; SET NOT NULL then skips the scan.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ADD CONSTRAINT account_user_opt_in_nn CHECK (marketing_opt_in IS NOT NULL) NOT VALID
ALTER TABLE account_user VALIDATE CONSTRAINT account_user_opt_in_nn
ALTER TABLE account_user ALTER COLUMN marketing_opt_in SET NOT NULL
ALTER TABLE account_user DROP CONSTRAINT account_user_opt_in_nn
